title: Autonomous Research Agent Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Research plans, source retrieval, experiments, evidence checks, and report generation for autonomous research agents. The Autonomous Research Agent Database records how an AI agent conducts end-to-end research without a human in the loop: it plans a research goal, retrieves sources, runs experiments or computations, checks evidence, and writes a cited report. Each record captures one reusable pattern — plan templates, source-retrieval strategies, evidence-grading rubrics, and report structures — so a research agent can be assembled from verified parts instead of improvised from scratch.

title: Autonomous Research Agent Database — Knowledge: technical reference
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. An autonomous research agent is a closed loop: PLAN (decompose goal into verifiable sub-tasks), ACT (retrieve sources, run tools), CHECK (grade evidence, detect contradictions), REPORT (synthesize with citations). Planning uses task graphs where each node has acceptance criteria; retrieval uses query expansion plus source-quality scoring S = w1*authority + w2*recency + w3*relevance; evidence grading assigns each claim one of {supported, partially-supported, unsupported, contradicted} with the contradicting source cited. Standard patterns: ReAct (reason-act-observe), plan-and-execute with replanning on failure, and critic loops where a second pass tries to falsify the draft. Provenance rule: every factual sentence in a report must trace to a source ID or be labeled agent-judgment.

title: Autonomous Research Agent Database — Execution: runnable tool
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Runnable workflow: (1) write goal + scope + budget to plan.json; (2) run the query-expander to produce search queries; (3) run the source-grader on retrieved documents; (4) run the claim-extractor on drafts and the evidence-checker against graded sources; (5) run the report-builder to emit the cited report. Each step writes JSONL logs so the whole run is replayable. The demo in each record executes the loop on a toy corpus: plan, retrieve, grade, check, report.

title: Autonomous Research Agent Database — Verification: tests and limitations
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Tests: plan-completeness test (every goal maps to at least one sub-task with acceptance criteria); retrieval-recall test (known-answer documents must rank in top-k); evidence-grade agreement test (two independent graders agree on >=80% of claims); citation-integrity test (every factual claim has a source ID that exists in the log); budget test (run halts at budget, never past it). Limitations: agents cannot verify claims outside their retrieved corpus; source-quality scoring is heuristic, not truth; long runs drift unless re-planned. Version history: research plans are versioned; reruns pin the plan version.

demo.title: Verification: calibration error (ECE)
demo.code: const pairs=[[0.9,1],[0.9,1],[0.9,0],[0.6,1],[0.6,0],[0.6,0]];const bins={};pairs.forEach(([c,ok])=>{const b=Math.round(c*10)/10;(bins[b]=bins[b]||{n:0,c:0,conf:0});bins[b].n++;bins[b].c+=ok;bins[b].conf+=c;});let ece=0;for(const b in bins){const B=bins[b];ece+=Math.abs(B.c/B.n-B.conf/B.n)*(B.n/pairs.length);}J({ece:+ece.toFixed(3)});assert(ece>0&&ece<1,'ece');

demo.code: const doc='alpha beta gamma. delta epsilon zeta. eta theta iota. kappa lambda mu.';const words=doc.split(' ');const chunks=[];for(let i=0;i<words.length;i+=4)chunks.push(words.slice(i,i+6).join(' '));const q='zeta';const hits=chunks.filter(c=>c.includes(q));J({chunks:chunks.length,hits:hits.length});assert(chunks.length===3&&hits.length===2,'rag');
